title: Unlawful Possession of Weapons
grade_or_penalty: Machine gun: 2nd degree. Handgun without a carry permit: 2nd degree. Rifle or shotgun without an FPIC: 3rd degree. Assault firearm: 2nd degree. Other weapons (knives, clubs and the like) under circumstances not manifestly appropriate for lawful use: 4th degree. Upgrades for school property
key_points: Knowingly possessing a firearm or weapon without the required license, permit or exemption.
Graves Act mandatory minimums apply to many firearm offenses.
elements: The suspect knowingly possessed the item (handgun, rifle, shotgun, assault firearm, machine gun or other weapon)
Firearms: the suspect had no permit to carry (handgun) or no firearms purchaser ID card (rifle or shotgun), and no exemption applies
Other weapons (knife, club, etc.): possessed under circumstances not manifestly appropriate for lawful uses
Note the location (school property raises the grade)

subsections.label: b
